approved_behavior: Target-source-date grouping under the source-reported unspecified clock basis

Equal averaging over rows within date, eligible dates within horizon, five quantiles and three horizons
Per-horizon-by-quantile pinball, median-head MAE, 90% coverage/width and scored-coverage reporting
Calibration-only nonnegative widening of the 0.05 and 0.95 endpoints with eligible/all day and row lineage
